name: Lau Pa Sat
description: 位于中央商务区核心地带的维多利亚时期八角形历史建筑，如今是熙熙攘攘的老牌小贩中心。入夜后，外面的道路会封闭成为烟火气十足的“沙嗲街”。
descriptionEn: A historic octagonal Victorian-era structure in the heart of the CBD, now functioning as a bustling heritage hawker centre. After dark, the adjacent road closes to traffic and transforms into a vibrant, smoky 'Satay Street'.
openingHours: 24小时营业（沙嗲街通常 7:00 PM 开始营业）
openingHoursEn: 24 Hours (Satay Street usually opens from 7:00 PM)
recommendNote: 晚上坐在摩天大楼下的街道上吃沙嗲烤串喝啤酒，是非常经典的新加坡体验。
recommendNoteEn: Sitting on the street under the skyscrapers at night, eating satay skewers and drinking beer is a classic Singaporean experience.
